about.heading: About BhoomiSetu
about.intro: Land records in India are split across survey departments, registration offices, planning authorities, and revenue records — each keeping its own version of the truth about the same piece of land. BhoomiSetu connects them around a single parcel, so anyone looking at a plot sees the same complete picture the government departments do.
about.missionBody: Every parcel has one canonical identity — searchable by ULPIN, survey number, plot number, or a local identifier — and pulls together its ownership records, registration status, land use and zoning, tax status, restrictions, disputes, encumbrances, and ownership history in one place. Citizens can verify a document against the official record in seconds instead of visiting three offices.
about.citizenBody: Search any parcel, verify land documents, track service requests, and see everything linked to land you own.
about.officerBody: Review and approve citizen requests, monitor governance alerts, and investigate spatial change on the ground.
about.adminBody: Manage staff accounts, audit platform activity, and see governance analytics across every parcel.

features.heading: What BhoomiSetu Does
features.intro: A parcel-centric view of land governance — built to connect departments that have never talked to each other, not to replace them.
features.searchBody: Find any parcel by ULPIN, survey number, plot number, or local identifier, then explore it on a real satellite map with adjacent and nearby parcels, zoning, and restriction overlays.
features.verifyBody: Upload a photo of a land document and have it checked against the parcel's actual official records — identifiers, owner name, and area — in seconds.
features.requestsBody: Request a copy of a record, report an issue, or file a dispute, then track its status through every department that needs to review it.
features.governanceBody: Officers review requests assigned to their department, act on governance alerts, and investigate satellite imagery for unauthorized change.
features.adminBody: Administrators manage staff accounts and see platform-wide analytics — tax status, disputes, workflow activity, and the parcels at highest risk.

hero.bodyP1: Checking your 7/12 extract, finding exact plot borders, or verifying ownership papers shouldn't take three trips to the Taluka office.
hero.bodyP2: BhoomiSetu links your registry papers, cadastral map lines, and revenue records in one simple dashboard — sign in to search, verify, and manage the parcels linked to your account.
hero.trustText: Government-verified records, securely linked to your own account.

home.howItWorksDesc: Three steps to manage your land records digitally.
home.step1Desc: Citizens create a free account; officers and admins sign in with credentials issued by their department.
home.step2Desc: Once signed in, search by ULPIN, survey number, or plot number to see full parcel details linked to your account.
home.step3Desc: Raise service requests, verify documents, and track every department's decision in one place.

citizen.searchDesc: Type your 14-digit Bhu-Aadhaar, survey number, or plot number to pull up ownership and mutation status.

citizen.verifyDesc: Upload a clear photo or PDF of your registered sale deed or 7/12 extract. We check if the owner names and plot numbers match government records.
